resolutions.keyAt: Making an observation and asking a question
resolutions.note: A reader’s note, not a sheet flag: the old stem ("the first step ... usually involving asking a question") telegraphed its own answer, so it tested reading rather than science. It now asks which step comes before forming a hypothesis, which needs the order of the method to answer.

resolutions.keyAt: To check that the results are consistent and reliable
resolutions.note: A reader’s note, not a sheet flag: three of the four distractors were jokes ("to confuse other scientists", "to use up extra materials"), so the item was answerable by elimination with no knowledge at all — the authored twin of a defect that appeared six times in the math content. All three are replaced with wrong answers a student might actually hold.
